data.title: Rejection of special-use permit application (Sondernutzungserlaubnis) for a moving container
data.summary: The Ordnungsamt of Stadt Musterstadt rejected Mara Beispiel's application of 2 July 2026 for a special-use permit (Sondernutzungserlaubnis) to place a moving container in front of Lindenweg 12, because the 1.40 m sidewalk there is too narrow for safe pedestrian passage. No objection procedure applies; a lawsuit (Klage) to the Verwaltungsgericht Musterstadt is the only remedy.
data.explanation: The city refused your request to place a moving container on the street outside your home, saying the sidewalk is too narrow for pedestrians to pass safely. There is no preliminary objection (Widerspruch) stage for this decision – you may instead decide whether to file a lawsuit (Klage) directly with the Verwaltungsgericht Musterstadt, in writing or by declaration to the court clerk's office, by the deadline shown in the app. If you do nothing, the rejection becomes final and you would need to find another solution, such as a smaller container or a different location. Consider getting legal advice if you want to challenge the decision.

key_facts.quote:
Ihren Antrag vom 02.07.2026 auf Erteilung einer Sondernutzungserlaubnis für das Aufstellen
eines Umzugscontainers vor dem Haus Lindenweg 12 lehne ich ab.

key_facts.label: Sidewalk width (Gehwegbreite)
key_facts.quote:
Der Gehweg ist dort nur
1,40 m breit; eine sichere Fußgängerführung wäre nicht gewährleistet.
